data.name: Hebah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘He’ meaning sun and ‘Bah’ meaning love, Hebah is the name of the Goddess of Love in Hindu mythology. She is depicted as a beautiful woman holding a lotus flower in one hand and a bow in the other. Hebah is also known as the Goddess of Marriage and Fertility, and is revered for her ability to bring harmony and joy to relationships.

By invoking the blessings of Hebah, one can cultivate a deeper appreciation for the power of love and the beauty of relationships.
